app.name: WiiFlix
app.coder: WiiFlix contributors (fork of WiiFin by fabienmillet)
app.short_description: Jellyfin client with a single-row cover browser
app.long_description: WiiFlix is a fork of WiiFin, the open-source Jellyfin client for the Nintendo Wii. It browses your library as one long line of cover art: Continue Watching first, then a row for every genre of your movies and TV shows. GPL-3.0.
